agreement.text: A PA with under 8,500 hours of post-graduate clinical practice works under written practice-level policies. For the first 4,000 hours the PA collaborates with a physician; between 4,000 and 8,500 hours a written collaborative agreement, with a physician or with a PA over 8,500 hours in the same specialty, is kept at the practice location and given to the board on request. Changing specialty restarts 4,000 hours of collaboration.
